    For the 2026 Carabao Cup Final on March 22, 2026,
    Arsenal started Kepa in goal with a defense of White, Saliba, Gabriel, and Hincapie, while Manchester City countered with a side featuring Haaland, Rodri, and O'Reilly. The match highlighted key tactical battles in midfield between Rice/Zubimendi and City's creative forces. 
    Arsenal XI (4-2-3-1): 
    • Goalkeeper: Kepa Arrizabalaga
    • Defenders: Ben White, William Saliba, Gabriel Magalhães, Piero Hincapié
    • Midfielders: Martín Zubimendi, Declan Rice
    • Attackers: Bukayo Saka, Kai Havertz, Leandro Trossard, Victor Gyökeres
    • Subs: Raya, Mosquera, Jesus, Martinelli, Norgaard, Madueke, Calafiori, Lewis-Skelly, Dowman 
    Manchester City XI (4-1-4-1): 
    • Goalkeeper: James Trafford
    • Defenders: Matheus Nunes, Khusanov, Nathan Aké, Nico O'Reilly
    • Midfielder: Rodri
    • Attackers: Bernardo Silva, Antoine Semenyo, Rayan Cherki, Jeremy Doku, Erling Haaland
    • Subs: Donnarumma, Reijnders, Stones, Marmoush, Kovacic, Nico, Ait-Nouri, Savinho, Foden 
    Key Notes: 
    • Arsenal's lineup featured Kepa Arrizabalaga starting in goal, a common theme for the Carabao Cup, as reported by OneFootball.
    • Manchester City's Nico O'Reilly was highlighted for an outstanding performance in midfield, according to the Manchester Evening News.
    • The match took place at Wembley Stadium on March 22, 2026, notes the Evening Standard.
